about_short_description.short_description: omnispay is a digital finance platform for payment collection, supplier payouts, and working capital management.

product.name: Business Payments for SMEs
product.description: A platform designed to help small and medium-sized enterprises manage payments and cash flow by simplifying how they pay suppliers and collect payments from customers.

product.name: Domestic Pay & Get Paid
product.description: A service that allows businesses to make and receive payments within the country with a transaction fee of 2.49% to 2.75% plus AED 1 per transaction.

product.name: International Pay & Get Paid
product.description: A service that enables businesses to handle international transactions with a fee of 2.85% to 3.1% plus AED 1 per transaction.

product.name: Payment Links
product.description: A feature that allows businesses to collect payments from customers via a link, which is valid for 30 days from the generation date.
